analysis.session_summary: The window was dominated by yen verbal intervention and geopolitics. JPY led early, +0.66% intraday, before fading 62% to close +0.258%; USD/JPY fell 65.6 pips. A U.S. sentiment beat lifted USD only briefly. Risk currencies (NZD, AUD, GBP) outperformed a soft USD while CHF lagged -0.207%.

themes.theme: Japan verbal intervention drives yen swings
themes.evidence: Katayama 'won't hesitate to take bold action' and Takaichi/Trump yen comments pushed USD/JPY down; JPY intraday peak +0.656%, closed +0.258%

themes.theme: U.S. data beat but USD stays soft; risk-on favors high beta
themes.evidence: Revised UoM beat 48.1 vs 47.4 produced a normal 0.047% USD lift; NZD +0.19%, AUD +0.028%, GBP +0.071% while USD -0.158%

themes.theme: Iran ceasefire headlines whip commodity FX and oil
themes.evidence: Iran-US talks and Trump ceasefire opposition swung USD/SEK, USD/ZAR and Brent; Brent fell then rebounded 5.768%

currency_drivers.USD: UoM beat gave a 0.047% lift, but broad USD remained soft at -0.158% as risk appetite favored high beta.
currency_drivers.EUR: No own releases; EUR held range, flat at -0.017%.
currency_drivers.JPY: Verbal intervention and Japan-US yen warnings drove early strength, but faded 62% to +0.258%.
currency_drivers.GBP: Bailey was muted (basket -0.014%); GBP held range with modest +0.071% from USD softness.
currency_drivers.AUD: No own releases; initial selling to -0.22% was rejected, recovering 87% to +0.028%.
currency_drivers.CAD: No own releases; CAD drifted -0.164% in a held range, largely tracking USD.
currency_drivers.CHF: No own releases; CHF was weakest at -0.207% without a clear catalyst.
currency_drivers.NZD: No own releases; NZD closed at its best +0.19%, supported by risk appetite.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD chopped through five legs—up 34.5, down 18.3, up 10.6, down 24.2, up 10.4—with no single catalyst; Katayama and Iran headlines only nudged parts.

polarity_reads.read: Normal polarity: beat surprise strengthened USD by 0.047%, with USD/MXN +0.196% and AUD/USD -0.084%; no inverted positioning.
Muted polarity: GBP basket moved -0.014% inside noise; event ignored, no positioning signal.

scenarios.name: Yen rhetoric persists, intervention risk stays high
scenarios.thesis: Verbal intervention from Japan (Katayama/Takaichi) and Bessent's strong-yen call keep JPY supported; any actual MoF action drives sharp JPY gains.
triggers: Further Japan MoF/BoJ verbal warnings or actual intervention
scenarios.invalidation: BoJ/MoF clearly reject intervention, U.S. yields spike higher

pair_paths.rationale: Today's verbal intervention drove USD/JPY down 65.6 pips; follow-through could match that.
CHF/JPY fell 88.7 pips as JPY strength and CHF weakness combined.
USD softness persists, EUR/USD gained 16.0 pips with no EUR catalyst.

scenarios.name: Risk-on de-escalation
scenarios.thesis: Iran-US ceasefire talks progress, oil falls, equities stabilize; high-beta FX (NZD, AUD) and GBP outperform, JPY weakens.
triggers: Confirmed Iran ceasefire or technical talks progress
scenarios.invalidation: Trump renews strikes, geopolitical risk flares

pair_paths.rationale: NZD/USD already rose 19.6 pips on risk appetite; de-escalation adds.
AUD/USD rose 13.1 pips today with risk recovery.
The UoM beat produced a 42.8-pip USD/JPY bounce; risk-on unwinds JPY haven.

scenarios.name: USD recovery on rates/Fed speak
scenarios.thesis: USD stabilizes as U.S. data continues positive and Lagarde sounds dovish; EUR/USD gives back, USD/JPY rebounds from verbal intervention fade.
triggers: Strong U.S. data or hawkish Fed comments
scenarios.invalidation: Weak U.S. data, JPY intervention escalates

pair_paths.rationale: EUR/USD had a 18.3-pip down leg; renewed USD strength could repeat.
USD/JPY bounced 42.8 pips on UoM beat; continuation if yields rise.
GBP/USD fell 7.8 pips on UoM beat; USD recovery pressures cable.

risks.why_it_matters: JPY is already +0.258% on verbal warnings; actual intervention could overshoot
risks.watch: Further Katayama remarks, MoF rate checks, sudden USD/JPY drops

risks.why_it_matters: Brent and high-beta EM swung sharply; can dominate short-term tape
risks.watch: Updates on Iran-US technical talks, Trump statements
